_meta.what: Hand-curated registry of upstream chokepoint holders in the AI hardware production chain. Per KARTO nation-axis spec v3 (finding F3'): this is a GLOBAL STATIC FACT, authored once and joined onto country records at build time. It is NEVER filled by the per-country extraction pass (a schema-filling LLM would launder the author's prior and, as review 2 proved, miss the two biggest holders — US and China).
_meta.maintenance: ~10 holders worldwide; set changes on a multi-year timescale. Review manually ~annually or on a major export-control / capacity shift.
_meta.node_meaning: A chokepoint node = the country holds a position in the AI hardware stack that others cannot easily route around. Downstream AI consumers depend on these nodes; the nodes are the leverage points on the geopolitical board.
_meta.sources_are_illustrative: Each holder lists the canonical public reference for the claim; these are the well-documented, widely-reported chokepoints, not exhaustive.

USA.detail: EDA duopoly (Synopsys, Cadence); Nvidia/AMD GPU design; fab-equipment majors (Applied Materials, Lam Research, KLA). Also the author of the export-control regime itself.

China.detail: Dominant refiner of gallium, germanium, rare earths; imposed export controls on gallium/germanium (2023) and rare-earth tech (2024-25), actively weaponized. Downstream chokehold on compound semis and magnets.

Taiwan.detail: TSMC — the overwhelming majority of leading-edge (<=5nm) logic and CoWoS advanced packaging for AI accelerators.

Netherlands.detail: ASML — sole producer of EUV lithography; no leading-edge chip exists without an ASML machine.

South Korea.detail: Samsung + SK hynix — the majority of HBM (high-bandwidth memory) that every AI accelerator requires.

Japan.detail: Photoresists and specialty materials (JSR, Tokyo Ohka, Shin-Etsu — silicon wafers); equipment (Tokyo Electron). Materials chokepoint demonstrated in the 2019 Japan-Korea dispute.

Israel.detail: Major accelerator/chip design centers (Nvidia's largest R&D outside the US via Mellanox; Intel Habana). Design node, not fabrication.

notes_on_boundary_calls.Germany: Zeiss supplies the optics inside every ASML EUV machine — a real sub-node, but folded under the Netherlands/ASML chokepoint rather than listed as an independent holder. Flag if precision needed.
notes_on_boundary_calls.Malaysia: Significant OSAT (assembly/test) capacity but not a chokepoint (substitutable); NOT listed.
notes_on_boundary_calls.Singapore: Wafer fabs and equipment presence but downstream/substitutable; NOT a chokepoint. It appears in the country set as a hyperscaler-hosted archetype, not a node holder.
